Company: JP Morgan Chase & Co., Bengaluru.
Duration: September, 2017 –  Present.
Role: Fund Accounting Associate (Team Manager). ,
Job Description:
NAV Calculation & Data Validation: Oversee daily trade capture for Equities, Fixed Income, FX and Derivatives; perform reconciliations and break-resolution to compute and publish NAV and related metrics in line with departmental SOPs.
Cross-Functional Coordination: Liaise with Client Services, NAV Valuation, Middle Office, Corporate Actions, Trade Support, Custody and IT to troubleshoot operational, valuation and accounting discrepancies; escalate critical breaks or process changes to protect daily valuation deadlines.
Accounting & Exception Management: Ensure straight-through processing of trades into settlement systems; clear the daily break-exception queue by EOD through booking, amending or cancelling duplicate trades; provide clients with timely status updates.
Audit & Compliance Oversight: Maintain and update SOPs; enforce operational-risk protocols prepare and deliver documentation for internal audits, external reviews and weekly on-shore/client calls.
Process Improvement & Projects: Identify, design and implement automation and workflow enhancements to boost efficiency and mitigate risk; lead system roll-outs and champion adoption of new procedures and mechanisms to meet evolving business needs, resulting in an 80% reduction in errors.
Team Leadership & Development: Train and mentor a team of five; allocate resources, conduct performance evaluations, recognize individual contributions and foster a culture of quality, timeliness and continuous learning.
Stakeholder Engagement & SLA Management: Own client and partner queries end-to-end—prioritize and resolve issues within agreed SLAs, escalate critical matters as needed and collaborate across departments to uphold risk controls.
Fund Accounting & Reporting Governance: Supervise monthly, quarterly and ad-hoc fund accounting deliverables; validate NAV computations, reconcile internal vs. client positions and ensure timely, accurate reporting under tight deadlines.
Company: Cognizant Technologies (UBS Bank), Hyderabad.
Duration: September, 2014 – September, 2017.
Role: Process Specialist (Team Leader).
Job Description:
Prime Brokerage Operations & Client Services: Provided comprehensive support to both Front Office Account Managers and Back Office teams in managing Hedge Fund and Prime Brokerage accounts across Fixed Income, Equities, Derivatives, FX, and OTC products, ensuring smooth trade lifecycle management and effective risk mitigation.
Process Transitions & Team Leadership: Successfully led a team of 4 during major process transitions within the FX Prime Brokerage unit, completing two end-to-end transitions and associated training programs, while driving operational improvement mechanisms and knowledge transfer, resulting in 75% reduction in errors.
Trade & Compliance Oversight: Oversaw trade support, settlement, collateral management, and corporate actions, while reviewing compliance documentation and managing trust operations in line with regulatory frameworks such as the USA Patriot Act, OFAC, and BSA.
Operational Excellence & Reporting: Maintained and updated SOPs in accordance with operational risk guidelines, managed capacity planning, acted as the escalation point for quality reviews, and delivered detailed weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports.
Stakeholder Engagement & Market Insight: Collaborated with global teams and stakeholders to stay informed on capital market developments, leveraging continuous learning and research to support strategic decisions and client portfolio management.
Company : Deutsche Bank, Bengaluru.
Duration : March, 2010 - August, 2014.
Role : Business Analyst.
Description :
Trade Capture & Validation: Accurately input and validate front-office trades (Equities, FI, FX, Derivatives) into the firm’s capture system, ensuring all pricing, legal-entity, settlement-instruction and regulatory fields are completed to support T+0/T+1 workflows.
Break Monitoring & Resolution: Review daily trade-capture reports to identify breaks or mis-books, then drive end-to-end resolution by partnering with Front Office, Middle/Back Office, Custodians and IT. Recommend and implement process or system enhancements to reduce fails and mitigate operational risk.
STP, Automation & UAT Leadership: Lead STP initiatives (FIX-feed mapping) and automation projects to streamline trade flows. Own User Acceptance Testing for system upgrades and new-product roll-outs, ensuring seamless integration and minimal business disruption, resulting in 90% reduction in errors.
Settlement Operations & Reconciliation: Execute Russian and DTC settlements for Fixed Income and Equities within Investment Banking Security Ops. Manage daily T+1/T+2 settlement cycles, verify confirmations and reconcile fails via Omgeo CTM, Bloomberg AIM and DTCC’s DTC Settlement System under strict regulatory guidelines.
Analytics, Reporting & Stakeholder Communication: Track KPIs (booking lag, error rates, fail volumes) to drive continuous improvement. Leverage advanced Excel scripting and Bloomberg Anywhere (live market feeds, CUSIP/SEDOL setups) to enhance process efficiency. Escalate issues rapidly via SWIFT and time-critical workflow tools, maintaining clear, proactive communication with all stakeholders.
